Blurred green trees and blue sky pass by the window, indicating movement. (2) The woman holds up a large green snack bag decorated with illustrations of coriander and colorful Chinese characters. She brings the bag close to the lens and then pulls it back, reacting with a wide-eyed, shocked, and amused expression. A black seatbelt strap is visible across her white top. (3) The scene cuts to a side-angle view of a man wearing a white baseball cap and dark reflective sunglasses in the driver's seat. He takes a thin, square green snack from the bag and places it into his mouth, chewing vigorously with his mouth moving rapidly. The background through the window shows a highway environment with passing vehicles and sunlight. (4) The man is shown from a front-facing perspective while still driving. He continues to chew the coriander-flavored snack with a satisfied look, occasionally sticking out his tongue or gesturing with his hand. The sunlight is bright, creating high-contrast shadows within the car cabin.
